The structure of Ce2Cu6Te8 (Ce(Cu3Te4)2) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Ce in a tetrahedral Te4 environment and Cu in a four-vertex environment with three Cu and one Te neighbor, while Te is five-coordinate with two Ce and three Cu. Corner-sharing between Ce tetrahedra and Cu polyhedra is observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites.
